newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo May construction works rise on April.
newsitem.headline: Yugo May construction works rise on April.

text.p: The Federal Statistics Office reported the following economic indicator details.
NOTES -- Cumulative number of workers in January-May period dropped 5.0 percent against the same five-month period 1996.
Number of hours put in by workers in May 1997 dropped 3.0 percent against the same month 1996 and cumulative January-May hours dropped 5.0 percent against the same period last year.

At the end of May, the value of concluded building contracts stood at 2.257 billion dinars compared to 1.851 billion dinars at end April. The data refer to conctracted construction works to be carried out during the year regardless of when the orders were made.
The data covers major constructon companies accountng for around 80 percent of total annual value of construction works.
The number of workers excludes engineers and technicians.
The number of hours excludes hours put in by engineers and technicians.
Figures refer to the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 311 4305
